title: AI operating systems workbook
task: Use the ownership lesson to write a task contract. Compare review time against the time the task takes by hand.

title: Run the offline agent lab
task: Save the file and run node --test lab.mjs with Node 22 or later. Inspect how a stale record is excluded. The fixtures run locally without a model account.

title: Evaluation rubric
task: Score one output for correctness, relevance, clarity and safety. Ask a peer to score it independently and discuss the largest disagreement.

title: Agent blueprint
task: Edit a local copy of the JSON. Replace the example goal, allowed tools and acceptance threshold with those for your task.

title: Workflow risk register
task: Use a row to record one likely failure, its owner and the evidence you will review before expanding a pilot.

title: Build a source-based AI workflow
task: Write a workflow, remove a necessary source and record what happens. Export the packet for a peer to review.

title: Anatomy of a production skill
task: Trace a customer-discovery skill from its trigger to its evaluation fixtures. Sketch the smallest folder your own skill needs.

title: Research to Working Agent: facilitator notes
task: Choose a paper and a no-paid-API fallback. Assign the host and producer, then rehearse the peer review before inviting learners.

title: Research translation record
task: Inspect the synthetic JSON example. Draft a hypothesis, baseline, rights decision and cost ceiling before recording a result.

title: Inside the Starlight skill pack
task: Inspect one skill in the pack and identify its trigger, tools and permissions. Check its terms before adapting it.

title: One agent or a quote-writing team?
task: Inspect the proposed experiment. Choose the same synthetic cases for both arms and account for reviewer time. The comparison is unrun.

title: The founder’s AI stack
task: Use the weekly audit to identify one recurring job and an existing tool to test on it. Record the cost before adding a subscription.

title: The Cartographer and the Coastline
task: Read the five-minute fable aloud. Discuss what a model of your own problem should leave out, and who gets to decide.

title: Community platform due-diligence worksheet
task: Open the CSV in a spreadsheet. Choose one member outcome and use its evidence and pass-condition columns to compare two options.

title: Starlight Community OS blueprint
task: Use the reference architecture to map which member records a group should be able to export. Identify the person responsible for consent.

title: Workshop adaptation guide
task: Choose a workshop template, review its agenda and substitute examples that fit your course before setting the assessment.

title: Collaborate with students at REC Impact
task: Review the university’s routes for organisations bringing a real-world problem. Check its current requirements before offering a brief.

title: Student networks at REC Impact
task: Find a student society whose interests match your brief. Follow its own participation route and check its current requirements.

title: A first accessibility review
task: Try the keyboard, headings and zoom checks on your prototype. Record a barrier and retest the correction with the person who encountered it.
